product_launches.description: Genesis AI unveiled Eno, its first AI-powered general-purpose robot, integrating the company’s GENE foundation model and proprietary dexterous hands to operate across industrial, service, and future consumer environments.

overview_description.description: Genesis AI develops full-stack general-purpose robotics systems that combine physical AI research, advanced hardware, and large-scale software. The company builds robotic foundation models that integrate language, vision, proprioception, tactile sensing, and control to enable complex manipulation tasks. It designs dexterous robotic hands and bimanual platforms that closely mirror human capabilities to transfer skills from human demonstrations to robots. Genesis AI operates a data engine that fuses glove-based motion capture, egocentric and third-person video, and internet data to train its robotics models. It also offers a high-fidelity physics simulation and rendering stack used for large-scale, closed-loop evaluation and training of robotic behaviors. Together, these components form a horizontal robotics platform intended to support general-purpose robots across diverse real-world workflows.
